rings.group: One ring starts without a flight
notes: All eighty birds begin in the same two rings. The left tangent speed is two toy units per beat; the right starts at zero. A still start is not a pinned position.
The same positions swap which ring starts with zero velocity. Local steering can change either ring after a beat.
Both rings start with zero velocity. Steering still runs when you take a beat; this is not a command to freeze the sky.
